TITLE: Returns – Reload Goes Back to the Returns Tab Instead of Credits
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: (owning story to confirm — regression item) · PRIORITY: Medium · LABEL: board-tech-view
MY READING: PROBABLY NOT A DEFECT — the chosen filter IS kept; only the selected tab goes back to Returns. The source (developer note) is about filters.

h2. Description

*Parts > Returns* should keep the user's place after a reload.

For example,
* on the *Credits* tab, a date filter is chosen
* after a reload the filter is kept, but the page opens on the *Returns* tab

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Open *Parts* > *Returns* and click the *Credits* tab.
# Choose *60 days* in the date filter.
# Reload the page.
#* The page opens on the *Returns* tab; the 60 days choice is kept.

*Actual Result:*
* After a reload the page opens on Returns, not Credits.

*Expected Result:*
* After a reload the Credits tab and its filter are kept.
